claims.disproof_condition: 條件：景碩後續季報、年報或法說寫出玻纖布供應恢復、不再影響營收或毛利，或寫明它的缺料與低熱膨張玻纖布無關。核查頻率：每季（景碩季報、法說）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence 或提撤回，重讀 IC 載板玻纖布層。
claims.statement: Kinsus's own FY2025 annual report (letter to shareholders, risk): raw-material shortages emerged from 2H2025, including glass fiber cloth and copper foil, together with rising copper and gold prices; these will continue to affect revenue growth and compress gross margin in 2026; countermeasures are seeking new raw-material suppliers and raising selling prices. The filing does not specify the glass-cloth grade (low-CTE T-glass vs. E-glass). Buyer-side first-hand (IC substrate maker).
